title: Editor’s Pick: Wild Bioscience - Nature Biotechnology
text:
Each year, Nature Biotechnology highlights companies that received sizeable early-stage funding in the previous year. Wild Bioscience is pursuing crop gene editing for higher yields and climate resilience.Alexander BedwellRoss Hendron, CEO and co-founder, Wild Bioscience
